<thought>Based on the most intense peak at m/z 276.0666, which likely corresponds to the protonated molecular ion [M+H]⁺, the neutral monoisotopic mass is approximately 275.059 Da. The isotopic pattern (M+1 ≈ 16 %) suggests around 15 carbons. A formula that matches this mass within a few ppm is C₁₄H₁₁O₆.</thought>
<final_answer>C14H11O6</final_answer>
